body:
Yateveo Man-Eater
CR 9

The mass of rotting foliage and vines drags itself forward, a great rotting maw opening to release a noxious gas.

XP 6,400
NE Large plant
Init +1; Senses darkvision 120 ft; all-around vision; Perception +19

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 10, flat-footed 19 (+10 natural, +1 Dex, -1 size)
hp 111 (11d8 + 55)
Fort +13, Ref +5, Will +8
DR 10/magic; Immune plant-traits, acid, poison and disease

OFFENSE

Speed 15 ft., climb 15 ft.
Melee bite +12 (2d6+ 9 plus grab and bad breath), 2 slams +12 (1d8+ 9)
Ranged digestive acid +8 (4d6 acid plus bad breath)
Space/Reach 10 ft./10 ft. (15 ft with slam)
Special Attacks breath weapon (30-ft cone, 5d6 acid damage plus bad breath, Reflex DC 19 for half, usable every 1d4 rounds), bad breath, digestive acid, swallow whole; poison

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 12, Con 19, Int 6, Wis 18, Cha 8
Base Atk +8; CMB +14; CMD 24 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Toughness, Defensive Combat Training, Improved Natural Attack (Bite), Improved Natural Attack (Slam), Horrific Gorging, Power Attack
Skills Perception +18

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Bad Breath (Ex)

The yateveo’s breath is sickeningly bad and can easily incapacitate an unprepared fighter. The yateveo’s bite and digestive acid attack make the target sickened for 1 minute (Fortitude DC 19 negates). Any targets that are sickened from bad breath are also exposed to the yateveo’s poison. If a target is already sickened, this effect increases to nauseated. The yateveo can use their bad breath as a breath attack, dealing 5d6 acid damage in a 30-ft cone. The saving throw is Constitution-based and the damage dealt by the breath weapon is 1d6 per 2 HD.

Digestive Acid (Ex)

As a standard action, the yateveo can spit a blast of acidic digestive acids at a target within 30 feet, dealing their bad breath damage and activating bad breath.

Poison (Ex)

Type injury; save Fortitude DC 19; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d3 Strength damage and 1d2 Con damage; cure 1 save.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm forests, jungles, and swamps
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

The yateveo is a disgusting pile of rotting vegetation that weighs several thousand pounds. It is given sentience by some foul deity of rot to feed and add to its noxious mass.
